findings.evidence: builtInSemanticDefaults[semanticType] and customSemanticDefaults[semanticType] use plain-object lookup with a consumer-supplied key, so inherited names such as 'constructor' or '__proto__' are truthy. deepMerge only copies enumerable own keys, so these merge nothing and no pollution occurs. This code is unchanged by this feature.
findings.description: Not exploitable today. Using Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call, as zestIcons.tsx already does, would remove the pattern for good. Optional hardening, not part of this change.
